$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: the evaluation job carries continue-on-error, which lets every step of it fail without failing the run, and no step-level check sees it.
Every other element is the capture's, so the result is that one deviation.
derivation: The file parses and lints clean and every element is present, but the job that runs tea-evaluate carries continue-on-error: true, so the result carries one rule violation.

ruleViolations: continue-on-error: on the job evaluation-pr, which runs an evaluation check
